messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — High DNS NXDOMAIN rate observed for geo-resolved endpoints in ap-southeast-1. Impact: ~10-14% of API requests returning transient DNS errors. Auto-escalation to on-call.
Alice M: paging Ben (oncall) — can you grab this? seeing customer errors and synthetic monitors failing in APAC.
Ben R: I’m on it. pulling resolver logs now. assigning Sev-2. setting comms channel.
SRE-Oncall: I see spike in NXDOMAIN from our edge resolvers hitting Cloudflare/Route53 combos. Counts: 1xx -> 5xx? no, NXDOMAIN specifically. starting query dump across resolvers.
Alice M: confirmed errors from internal synthetic (ap-southeast-1) and some customer reports in #support. ticket count rising.
Ben R: running dig against a few problem names. paste results:
```
$ dig +short api.redwood.internal @resolver-ap-southeast-1
;; -> (no answer)
$ dig +trace api.redwood.internal
;; got NXDOMAIN from 203.0.113.45
```
Ben R: looking at resolver health probes — some of our Cloudflare resolver endpoints returning SERVFAIL/NXDOMAIN intermittently. grabbing tcpdump.
infra-bot: historical note: we rolled a GeoDNS config change 6h ago to shift weight to ap-southeast-edge-2 for latency tests.
Emma L: I’m opening support ticket with Cloudflare and CCing Route53 contact — sharing traces and timestamps. link: https://support.cloudflare.com/ticket/RED-12345
Cloudflare Support: thanks — we've got the ticket. initial triage: a subset of authoritative edge nodes reported unusually high NXDOMAIN cache churn from upstream. collecting X-Trace.
Ben R: mitigation options — 1) failover GeoDNS to nearest non-affected region (eu-west) by adjusting weights, 2) temporarily increase resolver retries in our client-side library, 3) lower TTLs to accelerate propagation for any record updates. Immediate step: switch geo weight to eu fallback for ap-southeast prefix.
Mike T: we can flip weight via Route53 ChangeResourceRecordSets. JSON snippet ready:
```
{
  "Comment": "temporary failover: increase eu-west weight",
  "Changes": [
    {
      "Action": "UPSERT",
      "ResourceRecordSet": {
        "Name": "api.redwood.example.com.",
        "Type": "A",
        "SetIdentifier": "eu-fallback-temp",
        "Weight": 100,
        "TTL": 30,
        "ResourceRecords": [{"Value": "198.51.100.12"}]
      }
    }
  ]
}
```
Ben R: executing now. watch monitors.
SRE-Oncall: note: lowering TTL to 30s for quick failover. also enabling client-side retry backoff to 3 retries for ap-southeast only.
Alice M: notifying support teams and customers via status page draft — marking as partial outage in APAC region.
Ben R: Route53 change applied at 3161230468. Cloudflare still reporting intermittent NXDOMAIN on some edges but traffic now routing to eu-west via weighted record.
incident-bot: EVENT: DNS record change detected (Route53) — change-id Z1234X applied. propagation check started.
Emma L: support ticket updated with change-id and dig outputs. asking Cloudflare for ETA on autoritative node stabilization.
Cloudflare Support: we've observed cache stabilization after your weight flip — still seeing a small fraction of errored resolvers; our team is rolling a config patch to authoritative cache rules. ETA ~20-30m.
Ben R: monitoring error rate. apac errors dropped from ~12% -> ~1.5% in last 3m. rolling this as temporary mitigation. keeping TTL low for now.
Mike T: planning rollback steps: when Cloudflare confirms fix, we will revert weights and raise TTL back to 300. will coordinate a canary flip first.
Alice M: comms: posting incident update to status.redwood.ai — impact: partial DNS failures for APAC customers, mitigation in place (traffic routed to eu-west), ETA for full restore 30m.
SRE-Oncall: next steps: 1) wait for Cloudflare confirmation 2) run 15m canary to revert 3) post-mortem ownership assigned to Ben and Emma. capturing logs and resolver traces.
Ben R: handing over active lead to Emma (next shift) at 3161230480 — Emma will continue liaising with CF and run rollback canary.
Emma L: taking over. will watch global monitors and coordinate revert once CF confirms. updating incident doc.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity remains S2; last change at 3161230468; responders: Ben R -> Emma L. incident channel locked for responders only. :lock:
Alice M: thanks team — good quick mitigation. make sure we capture root cause and any config changes in runbook.
Emma L: logging for postmortem start: incident_id=INC-3161230456, primary symptom=intermittent NXDOMAIN from external resolvers, mitigation=geo-weight failover & TTL reduction, vendor action=Cloudflare authoritative cache fix. will schedule RCA meeting tomorrow.
